NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author squashed the test fix-up into the single commit (CI passes) and asked for the "not ready" label to be removed. No description or linked-issue changes were made, and the label came with no written feedback.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Fix-up commit squashed into one commit; CI passes |
| ❌  | No linked issue ("Fixes: #N"), so we can't confirm it's "help wanted"; the author has no merged PRs |
| ⚠️  | Description doesn't say which malformed `field_data` caused the 500 or how the fix handles it |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to link an existing "help wanted" issue, or open one for triage, and to improve the description.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for tidying up the commits! Before this can go to review, please link the issue this fixes with "Fixes: #N" (it needs to be labeled "help wanted"), and expand the description to say which malformed `field_data` caused the 500 and how it's now handled. See [making reviewable PRs](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) for details.
```
